annotations.title: Compare two US ETFs: overlap and risk

description: Two covered US ETFs: holdings overlap measured three ways (by weight, and the share of each fund held in common), the largest shared holdings, the correlation and covariance of weekly returns, and the cost, return and risk of each. Two fixed income funds overlap by issuer; another layer's fund is refused, with the reason.

a.description: A US ETF ticker, for example VOO. Case does not matter.
